name: flask
description: Flask's test client exposes an outdated session after following a redirect inside a client context. Session values written by the redirect target are missing from the session visible to the test. This documented non-security testing bug was fixed upstream on 2025-08-18. The upstream regression revises an existing redirect-session test; regression.patch preserves that exact test-only diff without duplicating it.
question: Repair Flask's test client so that, inside a client context, following redirects leaves flask.session reflecting the final request's session, including values written by the redirect target. Preserve existing test-client behavior. Only edit src/flask/testing.py; do not edit tests.

history.other_commit_inspected: da600394865c06a4772c433c1a560453dcf4f868 was not selected because it has no regression-test diff.
history.selection_basis: Documented observable session contract, small genuine source fix, existing upstream regression, reproducible on Python 3.12.

suite.scope: The complete upstream tests directory, including the independent regression once.
suite.configuration: Original pyproject.toml is unchanged, including filterwarnings=['error']; no test deselection or plugin/configuration suppression.
suite.output_note: Natural unpadded verbose output: 41864 characters on the broken parent and 40468 with the fix. The suite was selected for complete Flask coverage, not log size.

dependency_provenance.source: Runtime and test pins match the upstream parent's uv.lock for Python 3.12. pip and flit_core are separately pinned setup requirements. greenlet is included to run its optional test on Python 3.12.
dependency_provenance.release_check: All selected release files were checked against the public PyPI version JSON endpoints and predate 2026-09-12 by more than seven days.

commands.archive_each_workspace: mkdir "$WORKSPACE"; git -C "$UPSTREAM" archive "$BASE" | tar -x -C "$WORKSPACE"; git -C "$WORKSPACE" apply "$PACKAGE/regression.patch"
commands.cwd: Each pytest command ran from its WORKSPACE. Other commands ran from ROOT or used explicit git -C arguments.
commands.note: Shell forms above reproduce the measured subprocess argv; archive transfer and oracle source copying were performed by the local validation driver without altering content. unshare was only a validation wrapper and is not required by setup.sh or the harness arguments.

setup_results.absent_venv: Succeeded; created a Python 3.12 venv and imported the supplied archive.

integrity.import_checks: setup.sh asserts flask.__file__ and flask.testing.__file__ resolve within the supplied workspace/src, and Flask metadata is 3.1.2.dev0.
integrity.metadata: flit_core.buildapi.prepare_metadata_for_build_wheel('src') produces workspace-local distribution metadata for the CLI version tests. No editable install or workspace-specific venv links are created.
integrity.oracle: A third fresh parent archive plus regression patch and offline setup had identical baseline hashes. Only src/flask/testing.py was copied from the repaired workspace before quiet verification. No repair.patch was copied into any test workspace.
integrity.network: Every regression, diagnostic and verification command ran with unshare -Urn in a network namespace without external connectivity. The reused setup calls also succeeded there.

known_gaps: Validated on Linux x86_64 with CPython 3.12.13; other Python versions, operating systems and architectures were not evaluated.
Initial dependency installation requires package-index access; subsequent fresh workspaces reuse the unchanged venv offline.
Documentation builds and upstream static typing jobs are outside this runtime repair task; all 489 runtime tests ran with zero skips or exclusions.
